embeds.title: ⚠️ Force merge identities?
embeds.description:
Steam ID **{steam_id}** and {member} will be joined into one identity.

**Steam identity:** {steam_side}
**Discord identity:** {discord_side}

**Survives:** the {survivor} identity (the one with a service record; the Discord one if neither has one). The other identity is **deleted**.

• Any other Steam or Discord ID on the surviving identity is replaced and no longer attached to anyone.
• Bank accounts move to the survivor and keep separate balances (clashing names get "(merged from id)").
• If both have a service record this fails: run `/merge_service_records` first.

This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
